name: Vlad Vasile-Voiculescu - § 27/2
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: ‘stresses, too, that smoking cessation strategies and policies must be strictly aligned with scientific evidence relying on proven, independently verified and, where appropriate, clinically supervised methods; calls for enhanced monitoring and data collection on dual use and on the rising uptake of consumption of nicotine among non-smokers, young people and minors, to support evidence-based policymaking and targeted prevention strategies;’
